title: This Fish Poops Up to 800 Pounds of Beach Sand a Year

scenes.text: This fish poops hundreds of pounds of sand a year.
A big Hawaiian parrotfish can make up to 800 pounds of it.
It bites coral up to 20 times a minute.
Teeth in its throat grind the coral into fine white sand.
Hawaii gets almost no sand from land.
So much of its beach sand comes from animals like this.
That white beach? Partly fish poop.

description:
This fish poops hundreds of pounds of sand a year.
A large Hawaiian parrotfish can produce up to 800 pounds of sand a year by grinding coral. Hawaii receives very little sand from land, so much of its sand is biological.
Would you still lie on that beach? Tell us below.
first_comment: Scientists estimate some parrotfish make even more than 800 pounds a year. Would you believe 2,000?
